Current plans would see a crewed spaceflight from Artemis II, sending four astronauts on a 10-day flight around the moon and back. The soonest possible launch date is currently set at April 1. According to reports from Florida, NASA has five other dates available for launching the rocket in the first week of April. LiveNOW’s Mike Pache is speaking with Stephanie Buffamonte at FOX 35 Orlando, who is on the scene as the rocket prepared to get rolled out later this evening.
